verdict.rationale: Namecheap's first-party Go SDK documents one genuinely multi-item operation: checking availability of one or more domains in a single call. That is real but narrow bulk support. The other SDK operations listed (register, renew, lock) are per-domain, and the Terraform provider evidence describes per-record management rather than a bulk action. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond availability checks (bulk renew, DNS edits or lock changes across many domains), documentation of batch limits or behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
